scope: Synthetic mechanism stress test only; no manuscript data read or rescored.
construction: 8 pages x 6 lines x 10 tokens. Page preferences: independent tokens with correlated page sh and qok prevalence. Interior position: sh occupies slot2 and qok slot3, ch slot6 and dar slot7, regardless of word identity; endpoints fixed. Junction spelling: random qok placement, spell preceding chedy as shedy if next is qok. Repeated phrase: insert shedy qokam and chedy dar at randomly chosen nonoverlapping interior slots. No grammar in any generator.
statistic: Unchanged v94 ending_family and exact_body, both whole_line and fixed_endpoints nulls. Bonferroni16 retained. Store every trial, including failures.
criteria: For each view/null: page_preferences false-flag Wilson95 upper bound <=.10; junction_spelling and repeated_phrase detection Wilson95 lower bound >=.80. Interior_position is an adversarial diagnostic: rejection demonstrates lack of specificity to adjacency beyond interior positional structure; no requirement that it pass. These are finite authored controls, not universal qualification.
interpretation: Junction and phrase detections are genuine dependence, not false positives for association. They refute interpreting rejection as uniquely grammar. Interior-position flags show endpoint fixing is insufficient for this positional confound. No fresh manuscript holdout available; do not rescore or choose a revised test here.
